title: Grand Theft Auto VI
extract: Grand Theft Auto VI is a 2026 action-adventure game developed and published by Rockstar Games. It is the eighth main entry in the Grand Theft Auto series, following 2013's Grand Theft Auto V, and the sixteenth entry overall. Set within the fictional US state of Leonida, based on Florida, and in the fictional city of Vice City, based on Miami, the story follows the criminal duo of Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos as they lead a life of crime to escape from corrupted police officers. Players are able to freely roam Leonida's open world.
